items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: I met Panassie while I was with Sissle's orchestra at the Ambassador as he came to tea dance one day, and came backstage to see me.

ctx.x: Panassie. We -- as a matter of fact, I met Panassie while I was with Sissle's orchestra at the Ambassador as he came to tea dance one day, and came backstage to see me.
He must have been just a kid then?
